text: 11月4日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜会见了摩根士丹利集团董事长彭泰德，围绕当前中国及全球经济金融形势、中国金融业对外开放等议题进行了深入交流。（中国央行网站）
text_en: On November 4, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met with Morgan Stanley Chairman Ted Pick to exchange views on the current economic and financial situation in China and globally, and on opening up China's financial sector. (PBOC website)
